selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What picture does the passage give of the world at the beginning?
questions.answer: It shows the world like a great book or page full of many colors and signs.

questions.question: What does the “golden pen of power” point to?
questions.answer: It points to Allah’s power creating and arranging everything.

questions.question: Why does the passage say there is no dark spot for the heart’s eye?
questions.answer: Because the signs of Allah are shown so clearly that a believing heart can notice them.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the size of the world’s “book”?
questions.answer: It teaches that it has endless parts and countless events to read and think about.

questions.question: How is every being in the world described?
questions.answer: Each one is described like a meaningful word that shows truth and purpose.

questions.question: When all things speak together, what main message are they giving?
questions.answer: They are declaring Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: Besides declaring Allah’s oneness, what two beautiful calls are mentioned?
questions.answer: They call on Allah as the True One and the Living One.

questions.question: What sign is said to be found in all things?
questions.answer: Every thing has a sign that points to Allah being One.

questions.question: How did the heart and the nafs respond after hearing this message?
questions.answer: They accepted it and agreed that it is true.

questions.question: In the passage, what is creation compared to so that we can better understand it?
questions.answer: It is compared to a written work, like a book with pages, lines, and words.

questions.question: What do the “lines” of events in time suggest?
questions.answer: They suggest that many happenings take place and each one has meaning.

questions.question: What can we learn from calling every being a “word”?
questions.answer: We can learn that every creature carries a message and is not made without purpose.

questions.question: According to the passage, what sentence is all creation saying together?
questions.answer: All creation is saying that no one deserves worship except Allah.

questions.question: Why is the message of creation strong evidence for tawhid?
questions.answer: Because many different things all point to the same truth that Allah is One.

questions.question: Which part of a person is especially mentioned as able to notice these signs?
questions.answer: The heart’s way of seeing is especially mentioned.

questions.question: What happened inside the traveler after hearing these truths?
questions.answer: His inner self accepted them and confirmed them.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the whole passage?
questions.answer: The whole world is full of signs that clearly point to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: Why is careful looking important in this passage?
questions.answer: Because looking closely helps a person notice Allah’s signs in creation.

questions.question: What does light suggest in the passage when Allah’s signs are described that way?
questions.answer: It suggests clarity, guidance, and something easy to notice.

questions.question: What do the endless “dimensions” of the world’s book show?
questions.answer: They show that Allah’s creation is vast and full of meaning beyond what we can fully count.

questions.question: What do the countless events of time show about Allah’s works?
questions.answer: They show that Allah’s actions are many and continue again and again.

questions.question: What words do all things use together to show worship and belief?
questions.answer: They use words that declare Allah’s oneness and call on Him with praise.

questions.question: If all things give the same message, what can we infer about their Maker?
questions.answer: We can infer that their Maker is One.

questions.question: What lesson does the response of the heart and nafs give to the reader?
questions.answer: It teaches that a person should accept clear truth when it is recognized.
